jobs_results.title: Online Data Analyst - Spain
jobs_results.description:
TELUS International AI-Data Solutions partners with a diverse and vibrant community to help our customers enhance their AI and machine learning models. The work of our AI Community contributes to improving technology and the digital experiences of many people around the world. Our AI Community works in our proprietary AI training platform handling all data types (text, images, audio, video and geo) across 500+ languages and dialects.

We offer flexible work-from-home opportunities for people with passion for languages. The jobs are part-time , and there is no fixed schedule. Whoever you are, wherever you come from, come join our global AI community. www.telusinternational.com

We are hiring freelance English and Spanish speaking Online Data Analysts for a project aimed at improving the content and quality of digital maps, which are used by millions of users globally. The job would suit someone who is detail-oriented, likes doing research and has a good knowledge of national and local... geography.

This is a freelance position on a flexible schedule - you can work in your own time whenever work is available. You will be completing research and evaluation tasks in a web-based environment, eg verifying and comparing data, determining the relevance and accuracy of information. You will be provided with guidelines for each task, which need to be followed.

Requirements
• Full Professional Proficiency in English and Spanish
• You must be living in Spain the last 2 consecutive years
• Ability to follow guidelines and do research online using search engines, online maps and website information
• You must have familiarity with current and historical business, media, sport, news, social media and cultural affairs in Spain
• Being open to work across a diverse set of Task Types (e.g. Maps, News, Audio tasks, Relevance)
• Willingness to learn and adapt to changing guidelines and tasks
• Applicants must be 18 years or over.

Working on this project will require you to go through a standard recruitment process (including passing an open book assessment). This is a long-term project and your work will occasionally be subject to quality assurance checks.

Why Join the TELUS International AI Community?
• Earn additional income with flexible hours to fit your lifestyle
• Better work-life balance
• Be your own boss
• Complimentary Well-Being package encompassing a wealth of well-being resources.
• Be part of an online community

Payment

Rate of pay per task is inclusive of reading task guidelines. Payment will be issued in accordance with the terms of the contributor agreement upon successful completion of tasks.

Additional Job Description

We are hiring freelance English & Spanish speaking Online Data Analyst’s for a project aimed at improving the content and quality of digital maps, which are used by millions of users globally. The job would suit someone who is detail-oriented, likes doing research and has a good knowledge of national and local geography.

EEO Statement

At TELUS International, we enable customer experience innovation through spirited teamwork, agile thinking, and a caring culture that puts customers first. TELUS International is the global arm of TELUS Corporation, one of the largest telecommunications service providers in Canada. We deliver contact center and business process outsourcing (BPO) solutions to some of the world's largest corporations in the consumer electronics, finance, telecommunications and utilities sectors. With global call center delivery capabilities, our multi-shore, multi-language programs offer safe, secure infrastructure, value-based pricing, skills-based resources and exceptional customer service - all backed by TELUS, our multi-billion dollar telecommunications parent.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At TELUS International, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity

jobs_results.title: Analista de Datos Senior
jobs_results.description:
Descripción del proyecto:

Desde una visión customer-centric y explotando grandes volúmenes de datos, se desarrollarán e implementarán soluciones de analítica de datos y generación de insights que aporten valor al negocio.

Funciones principales:

-Análisis, y visualización: generación de insights que permitan lanzar acciones, decisiones o explorar oportunidades de desarrollo de negocio; análisis del comportamiento de clientes de compra/contratación, CLTV; generación y mejora de herramientas analíticas como dashboards o reportes que aporten facilidades analíticas a la compañía.

-Explotación de base de datos a gran escala: inspeccionar, limpiar, transformar, modelar datos y elaborar datasets; automatización de procesos / diseño e implementación de pipelines; liderar discusiones con el equipo de ingeniería de datos para definir y diseñar soluciones que satisfagan nuestras necesidades de datos

-Conteos y segmentaciones: definición e implementación de segmentaciones estratégicas... tácticas y KPIs para cuadros de mando para analizar el comportamiento del cliente

- Gobierno, calidad del dato, compliance: colaborar con el responsable de data governance para la implementación de un correcto gobierno del dato y de las medidas de calidad establecidas.

-Colaboración en Proyectos: participación en proyectos data driven de los grupos ECI/Mutua Madrileña.

Se requiere:

-Grado universitario: matemáticas, estadística, ingeniería, administración empresas, económicas etc

-Inglés B 2

-SQL avanzado, PYTHON médio, Power BI avanzado,+Ofimática avanzada, explotación BBDD clientes, experiencia en cloud + Onpremise Data warehouses,

-Experiencia similar 5 años

Deseable:

-Experiencia SAP Hana, Experiencia SQL Server,

-Experiencia en Retail y/o Sector Seguros

Beneficios sociales:

• Trabajo híbrido

• Seguro Colectivo de Vida.

• Plan de Aportación Definida

• Programa de retribución flexible

• Oferta formativa.

• Descuentos y beneficios en la Tarjeta de Compra de ECI

• Formación Universitaria.

• Ayudas al Estudio para hijos de empleados

• Se valorarán conocimientos en Python, Talend, BigQuery, Airflow, Machine Learning e Inteligencia Artificial.

OTROS DATOS:
• Modalidad de trabajo: presencial.

¡Únete a nuestro equipo y se parte de una empresa en crecimiento donde tu trabajo tendrá un impacto significativo

jobs_results.title: Supply Chain Data/Business Analyst (f/m/d)
jobs_results.description:
Workload: 100%

Join our dynamic Axpo team in Madrid as a Supply Chain Data/Business Analyst, where your expertise will drive the transformation of our Group-wide supply chain data. Engage in pioneering work to redefine how we analyze, structure, and leverage data to streamline our operations and enhance decision-making processes.

What you will do:
• Conduct an initial comprehensive analysis of our Group-wide SCM data, setting the foundation for data-driven excellence.
• Spearhead initiatives to improve data quality, structure, and accessibility, ensuring our supply chain's efficiency and effectiveness.
• Develop and implement a KPI dashboard using SAP Ariba Analytics and MS Power BI, making critical data readily available to stakeholders.
• Generate insightful analyses and reports, advising departments on SCM data utilization, driving strategic decisions across the organization.
• Foster collaboration across teams, identifying opportunities for process optimization and cost savings... through data analytics.

What you bring & who you are:
• A Master's degree in Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or Computer Science, complemented by 5-8 years of relevant experience.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Python, Microsoft Power BI; knowledge of SAP Ariba Spend Analytics is a plus.
• A deep understanding of big data analytics, data modeling, and visualization, with a solid foundation in mathematics and statistics.
• Strong communication skills, an open mindset, and a passion for leveraging data to solve complex problems.
• Fluency in English; German and other languages are advantageous.

About the team:

Be part of a forward-thinking team that values innovation, collaboration, and a commitment to excellence. At Axpo, we're not just working together; we're shaping the future of energy through groundbreaking projects and cutting-edge technology. Join us and contribute to an environment where your work makes a real impact

jobs_results.title: Data Analyst (CPaaS Reselling)
jobs_results.description:
Vonage Product Management Mission: Vonage is the emerging leader in the $100B+ cloud communications platform (CPaaS) market. Customers like Airbnb, Viber, Whatsapp, Snapchat, and many others depend on our APIs and SDKs to connect with their customers all over the world. As businesses continue to shift to a real-time, customer-centric communications model, we are experiencing a time of impressive growth.

Why this role matters

As the Data Analyst on our team, your role is instrumental in shaping our data into a compelling narrative that drives informed decision-making. Data is the lifeblood of our organization, and your expertise will be a catalyst for positive change. By harnessing your analytical skills, you will empower us to enhance the quality and efficiency of the services we offer to both our internal and external stakeholders. Through data analytics and alerting, you will play a pivotal role in optimizing our operations, improving customer experiences.

IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE... YOU, CONTINUE READING BELOW…….

What You Will Do
• Support the technical execution of our monitoring needs, data analytics, testing, and automation.
• Build, Maintain and Improve alerts on identified fields of each function of our team, to better Monitor and support our products.
• Liaise with our Data and Core teams to identify ways of improving the Data consumption for our projects and framework.
• Work through a variety of technical challenges that will require creativity and close collaboration across internal functions.

What You Will Bring
• The ability to work with cutting-edge data analytics tools and technologies will be a valuable asset in harnessing the full potential of our data resources. You will not only monitor and analyze data but also develop alerting mechanisms to identify anomalies, trends, and potential issues in real-time, ensuring a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Required

What is required for application
• 3-5 years of experience in Data Analysis and/or Analytics.
• Skilled in reporting and data visualization software (Tableau BI or similar)
• Exposure in Elasticsearch and its’ modules/extensions/language (Kibana, X-Pack, lucene query language)
• Experience with Python.
• Experience with SQL.
• Experience with version control systems like Git
• Creative and keen to learn new technologies
• Self-starter who is also comfortable working individually as well as part of a team.
• Inquisitive mindset, with a strong eye for detail.
• Comfortable in planning, leading, and delivering complex data solutions to improve performance and to deliver improved alerts.
• Have a strong quantitative analytical background and be able to draw out key information from large datasets.
• Excellent communication skills, able to explain data concepts to non-technical audiences.
• Project management skills with experience of working collaboratively with colleagues across large organizations

Nice to have
• Understanding of the b2b cloud communications industry, including but not limited to WebRTC, A2P messaging (Kafka), or VoIP.
• Experience in writing ETL/ELTs
• Experience with Machine Learning libraries
• Computer Science degree preferred but not required.

What Is In It For You
• Private Medical Insurance
• Pension
• Group Life Assurance
• Optum EAP (Employee Assistance Programme)
• Unlimited Discretionary Time Off
• Three Paid Volunteer Days a Year

Potential Next Career Move: Senior Data Analyst

jobs_results.title: Analista PL/SQL - ETL con inglés
jobs_results.description:
En Arelance sabemos que las personas son el activo más importante dentro de una empresa y por tanto invertimos muchos esfuerzos en buscar los mejores profesionales para nuestros clientes y en ofrecer a nuestros candidatos los mejores proyectos.

En este momento buscamos un profesional con experiencia en desarrollo PL/SQL con experiencia en desarrollo de ETL y visualización de datos para trabajar 100 en remoto desde cualquier punto de España.

¿Qué buscamos ti?
• Experiencia requerida Más de 3 años en el rol
• Tengas fluidez de forma oral y escrita en inglés
• Busques formar parte de un proyecto internacional

Funciones a realizar
• Desarrollar mantener y mejorar las aplicaciones existentes utilizando Oracle PL/SQL.
• Colaborar con otros equipos para diseñar e implementar soluciones eficientes y escalables.
• Participar en el diseño y desarrollo de procesos ETL para integrar datos de múltiples fuentes.
• Desarrollar consultas complejas y procedimientos almacenados para la extracción... transformación y carga de datos.
• Contribuir al diseño y desarrollo de informes y paneles de visualización de datos.
• Realizar pruebas de código depuración y optimización de consultas para garantizar un rendimiento óptimo.
• Mantener la documentación técnica adecuada y proporcionar soporte técnico cuando sea necesario.

¿Qué ofrecemos en esta posición?
• Acceso a formación
• Contrato indefinido en Arelance
• Banda salarial a negociar según experiencia aportada (De 35 a 39K B/A)
• Modalidad de trabajo 100 en remoto.

Si tienes interés en una gran oportunidad como ésta ¡inscríbete! ¡Queremos conocerte!

Sólo se valoran candidatos con permiso de trabajo y residencia en España

oracle, plsql, pl/sql, etl

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador de datos y analista ETL
jobs_results.description:
¡Apiux está buscando un/a Desarrollador de datos y analista ETL, España!

Somos una empresa tecnológica especializada en apoyar a organizaciones de todas las industrias en su proceso de Transformación Digital. Estamos presentes en Chile, Perú, Colombia, EE. UU, España y seguimos en constante expansión.

Responsabilidades y funciones:
• Realizar actividades ETL (Extracción, Transformación y Carga de datos).
• Programación en Python para el desarrollo de scripts y procesos de manejo de datos.
• Utilizar de forma experta bases de datos relacionales, especialmente SQL.
• Conocimiento y experiencia en el uso de SSIS (Integration Services) y SSAS (Analysis Services).
• En caso de ser posible, mantener y crear informes utilizando PowerBI.
• Colaborar en la creación y mantenimiento de pipelines de datos en la nube, especialmente en AWS y/o Azure.
• Experiencia deseable en el uso de Airflow para la creación, monitoreo y reprocesamiento de procesos automáticos.

Requisitos mínimos:
•... Experiencia mínima de 2 años
• Programación en Python u otro lenguaje de manejo de datos.
• Experiencia avanzada en bases de datos relacionales y SQL.
• Conocimientos de SSIS y SSAS.

Conocimientos deseables:
• Experiencia en despliegue en la nube, especialmente en AWS y/o Azure, y generación de servicios de Data Pipelines.
• Conocimiento de PowerBI para mantenimiento y creación de informes.
• Familiaridad con Airflow para la automatización de procesos.

Beneficios:
• Contrato indefinido
• Trabajo 100% remoto
• Rango salarial 25K a 27K SBA en función a la experiencia
• 23 días de vacaciones hábiles por año laborado
• Apiux Academy: Formación, entrenamientos técnicos e interacción con la comunidad tech para desarrollar tu talento al máximo.
• Clases de inglés
• Profesor de inglés 24/7.
• Día de tu cumpleaños libre.

jobs_results.title: Sourcing Data Analyst Internship
jobs_results.description:
Duration: Minimum 12 months

Location: Barcelona (Poblenou)
• *Please submit your CV and cover letter in English**

Company Overview:

NSI is a leading player in the natural food industry committed to delivering high-quality, sustainable, and ethically sourced products to our customers. We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Sourcing Data Analyst to join our team and play a pivotal role in enhancing our sourcing and procurement processes.

Responsibilities:

Import/Export Data and Market Analysis:
• Analyze import/export data of key commodities in the natural food industry.
• Monitor market prices, trends, and fluctuations to provide valuable insights to the sourcing team.

Supplier Database Management:
• Create, populate, and manage a comprehensive supplier database.
• Gather and update key information on suppliers obtained from various sources, ensuring accuracy and relevance.

Sourcing And Procurement KPIs Analysis:
• Generate and analyze sourcing and procurement Key... Performance Indicators (KPIs).
• Provide regular reports and insights to optimize sourcing strategies.

Pricing Database Management:
• Develop and manage a pricing database, recording daily prices received from suppliers.
• Ensure data accuracy and use insights to negotiate favorable pricing agreements.

Global Calendar Creation:
• Create a global calendar for each commodity, detailing seasonality, main producing countries, acres grown, production estimates, etc.
• Provide timely information to support strategic decision-making in sourcing.

Sourcing App Development:
• Design and implement a sourcing app to streamline data collection during Trade Shows.
• Automate the upload of supplier data to the central database for seamless integration.

ERP Support For Contract Management:
• Support the sourcing team in contract creation and management within the Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system.

AI Integration:
• Drive the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools in the sourcing department.
• Explore AI applications for vendor onboarding, forecasting, price changes, and identifying potential crop disruptions.

The Ideal Candidate Will Have:
• Proven experience in data analysis, preferably in the natural food industry.
• Proficiency in data visualization tools and techniques.
• Knowledge of sourcing and procurement processes.
• Experience with ERP systems and contract management.
• Familiarity with AI and machine learning concepts is a plus.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Required Education And Experience:
• Master’s degree in Data Science, Business, Supply Chain Management, or related field. GAP year students will not be considered.
• Must have professional proficiency in English (oral and written)

Work Environment:
• Hybrid work schedule with at least three (3) days per week in-office
• Candidates must be flexible in regards to their schedule to accommodate working with an international team

Company Overview:

NSI is a leading player in the natural private label food industry, dedicated to providing high-quality, organic, and sustainably sourced food products to consumers. We believe in promoting healthy and conscious eating choices, and our range of products reflects our commitment to quality and sustainability. As we continue to grow and expand our market presence, we are seeking an experienced and dynamic Sourcing Data Analyst Intern to join our team and drive the creation of exciting, nutritious, and eco-friendly products

jobs_results.description:
INSE-23519-EP/MAD - Técnico Analista de Datos para USAP MIVAU

Localidad: Madrid

Provincia: Madrid

País: España

Nº Vacantes (puestos): 1

Oficina: CONSULTORÍA

Tipo de oferta: PLANTILLA / ETT / OFERTA

Descripción

Ingeniería y consultoría de referencia en el ámbito de la movilidad sostenible y la transformación digital

Ineco lleva 55 años diseñando soluciones integrales, innovadoras y tecnológicas que han permitido avanzar hacia un nuevo modelo de movilidad más sostenible y más segura. Soluciones que contribuyen de manera directa en la mejora de la calidad de vida de millones de personas.

Con un equipo multidisciplinar de 5.500 profesionales, la empresa está presente en todos los continentes donde despliega su experiencia y capacidad para afrontar trabajos técnicamente complejos gracias a su conocimiento especializado y a la aplicación de la tecnología más avanzada y vanguardista.

Funciones

Elaboración y Análisis de bases de datos.
Explotación y presentación de datos mediante... programas tipo Power BI, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint o programas análogos.
Integración de múltiples fuentes de datos

Requisitos

Experiencia en: Identificación, obtención, consulta y análisis de datos obtenidos en Excel, archivos CSV u otros formatos de BBDD como MS Access.
Análisis, presentación y comunicación de resultados. Uso de aplicaciones tipo cuadro de mando. Aplicaciones tipo Power BI. Análisis Big data.
Valorable experiencia en automatización de procesos para recopilar y hacer seguimiento de los datos.
